stage3: Stage 3 — a sweep follows each charged shot
briefing: It circles you fast, stopping and dashing suddenly. You can't fly through the hull (hitting it costs about 80% of your HP). When it's off screen, follow the cyan marker on the edge

A blue barrier usually blocks your fire. It drops just before each beam (while the rim band is dark, attack; the top dome is a weak point). The 3 generators hanging below sit outside the barrier and can always be hit (each one keeps the barrier down longer)
Sweep: when two lines glow from the front rim, climb or dive away from them. LOCK: a line from the cannon tracks where you are heading. When it stops, turn hard (flying straight gets you hit)
Light orbs: when the rim flashes white, it scatters orbs where you're heading. Turn and they miss
Warp: it jumps to where a white pillar of light appears (a white edge marker if off screen). Destroy the 4 rim emitters to stop the warps
